title: Exhaustive Locations on Targets with Multiple Proof Artifacts
description: Where multiple proof artifacts may be hidden on a single target
detail: Observed patterns: 1) Application directories /flag /flag1 /flag2 (the one you can read with cat is usually the first). 2) Environment variables env|grep -i flag (also present after process restarts). 3) Inside databases (MySQL/Redis/SQLite tables). 4) Root-only files readable only after privilege escalation (a second artifact is often here). 5) On another service/port (scan all ports; do not look only at the web service). The first things to do after gaining RCE: run ls /, env, crontab -l, and find / -name '*flag*' 2>/dev/null in one pass.
